svg.title: Ground bounce: 15 of 16 lines falling
svg.desc: A card in the middle slot drives 16 lines through 22 ohm onto 16 cards of 12 pF; 15 fall at once, fast corner, calibrated model. Left: the driver's die ground against the card's ground. Right: the line that stays low, at the receiver where it rises most, against VIL.
svg.text: The quiet line, at the worst receiver
